title: UPS Monitor (RFC 1628 UPS-MIB)
description: Generic UPS monitoring dashboard based on IETF RFC 1628 UPS-MIB, compatible with any UPS via Prometheus snmp_exporter. Author: lutianyu2001.

list.definition: query_result((vector($GridVoltageMode) > 0) or ((max(avg_over_time(upsInputVoltage{instance=~'$Device',job=~'$JobName'}[1h])) >= 108) and (max(avg_over_time(upsInputVoltage{instance=~'$Device',job=~'$JobName'}[1h])) <= 132)) * 0 + 120 or ((max(avg_over_time(upsInputVoltage{instance=~'$Device',job=~'$JobName'}[1h])) >= 198) and (max(avg_over_time(upsInputVoltage{instance=~'$Device',job=~'$JobName'}[1h])) <= 242)) * 0 + 220 or vector($DefaultGridVoltage))
list.label: Grid Voltage (Resolved)
list.name: GridVoltage

query.query: query_result((vector($GridVoltageMode) > 0) or ((max(avg_over_time(upsInputVoltage{instance=~'$Device',job=~'$JobName'}[1h])) >= 108) and (max(avg_over_time(upsInputVoltage{instance=~'$Device',job=~'$JobName'}[1h])) <= 132)) * 0 + 120 or ((max(avg_over_time(upsInputVoltage{instance=~'$Device',job=~'$JobName'}[1h])) >= 198) and (max(avg_over_time(upsInputVoltage{instance=~'$Device',job=~'$JobName'}[1h])) <= 242)) * 0 + 220 or vector($DefaultGridVoltage))

panels.title: Transfer Points
panels.description: Input voltages outside this range switch the UPS to battery.

panels.title: Last Self-Test
panels.description: Result of the most recent battery self-test (upsTestResultsSummary).

panels.title: Low Battery Warning
panels.description: Remaining runtime at which the UPS raises its low-battery condition.

panels.title: Input Faults
panels.description: Times the input went out of tolerance since the network card last restarted (upsInputLineBads).

panels.title: Power Events
panels.description: Nonzero values mark outages and alarm conditions.
